title: Faster answers and a bigger question box
changes: Answers are built to finish within about 30 seconds.
The question box is larger and easier to read.
Set your company logo and colour in Settings and they appear on your PDFs.

title: Month-end pack and calculation panel
changes: Download a ZIP with the PDF and Excel file in one click.
Open "How was this calculated?" under any answer to see the steps and assumptions.
Reconciliation differences become cases you can mark resolved.
